text: EventSeries owns the validated source Recording and exact half-open ranges; fixation dispersion carries declared, source-supported, recomputed, or explicit-unavailable evidence; transform identity is the closed SpatialTransform algebra, not a rendered string. General warps rebuild fixation centre and named dispersion from original usable source samples, preserve source-origin lineage, transform pursuit/saccade geometry, and explicitly require re-estimation of measured peak velocity. Detached Scanpaths invalidate spread with a named reason; source-backed Scanpaths reconstruct it.
